model.name: swUpdate.pollForUpdate
model.description: While the app is open, periodically force an update check (setInterval ~60s + on visibilitychange-visible / window focus, debounced): call registration.update() to force the browser to re-fetch sw.js (bytes change per deploy via CACHE_NAME bump -> updatefound -> existing banner path) AND re-run the /api/config version compare. Makes a new deploy visible WITHOUT a hard-refresh.
